ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels; high local contrast at borders of mottled regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity zone at the fluke origin; heavy white mottling and vertical streaking on the lateral lobes; distinct high-intensity circular nodes distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped indentation; interior angle measured at approximately 45 degrees; apex is narrow but rounded.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations; significant notch (approx. 50 pixels deep) on the right lobe distal margin; jagged profile along the entire continuous boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep from the median notch to the distal tips; sweep is interrupted by irregular tissue loss and heavy barnacle accumulation at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular target-like clusters (dark outer ring, light inner core) concentrated in the lower-left and mid-right regions of the fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned dark vertical and diagonal line segments (rake marks) cutting through the white pigmentation on the left lobe and outer right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive accumulation of high-relief, high-intensity textured masses (barnacles) on both distal tips; widespread circular scarring consistent with parasitic or barnacle attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique pair of adjacent concentric circular marks on the lower left lobe near the fluke midline.
